svg.font-family: Hanken Grotesk, Segoe UI, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Ten rows mapping each verdict the surface produces onto what it contributes to the composed certificate. A gate allow, a passing effect and a grounded premise each contribute verified. A gate denial, a failed effect, a refusal by the effector and an ungrounded premise each contribute refuted, and one refuted input makes the whole certificate refuted. An escalation to a human and a weak premise contribute unverifiable, which pulls a verified result down without making it false. The last row is accented: a verdict string none of the maps recognizes becomes unverifiable rather than raising.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: What each verdict contributes to the certificate an action carries

g.text: The operator's grant covers this exact action and target, so the
pre-execution gate raises nothing against it.

g.text: No grant covers the action. Nothing downstream can compose a
denial away, so the whole certificate is refuted.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: The gate escalated rather than deciding. An escalation never
rounds up to a pass, so the certificate stays open.

g.text: The surface read the target back after acting, and what landed

g.text: The re-read does not match the plan. A reversible action is
undone, and the certificate says so either way.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: The effector declined a gate allow, because the target sat
outside its bound or the content did not match the preview.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: The premise the action cited resolved to supporting references,
and their digest is carried in the evidence.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: References were found, but thin. A weak premise pulls a verified
effect down instead of passing through it.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: Nothing supports the premise. The action does not run at all, it
escalates, and the certificate is refuted.

text.font-family: Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
Conso, ui-monospace, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

g.text: A verdict string none of the three maps knows degrades to
unverifiable and never raises. A typo reads as caution rather

svg.text: The composition is a lattice meet proven commutative, associative and monotone, so no arrangement of steps turns a worse verdict into a better one.
Refuted absorbs, unverifiable attenuates, and only an unbroken run of verified inputs composes to verified.
